title: Cover does not stay on well
text: Cover does not stay on well. I did not like how the top at times had to be held on by my fingers so it wouldn’t fall off.

product_metadata.title: Luigi Bormioli Thermic Doublewall Travel Mug,Gray
features: Includes one mug with one removable lid
description: The Thermic collection by Luigi Bormioli is a complete offering of double wall glasses designed for a variety of hot drinks and cold drinks alike. These glasses are sure to bring a level of sophistication and elegance to the enjoyment of your favorite beverage. The Thermic Travel Mug keeps cold beverages cold without the usual condensation, and it keeps hot beverages warm while the glass on the outside is cool to the touch. Made of borosilicate glass, it is durable yet lightweight. The Travel Mug is 16-ounces in capacity, 8 1/2-inches tall and comes with a removable lid.
